findings.body:
**Preserve quoted SSH option boundaries.**

In `src/ops/review/addressMany.ts`, Line 131 rewrites `ssh "-oBatchMode=no"` into `ssh " " -oBatchMode=yes`. The quoted space remains an argument. Git interprets `GIT_SSH_COMMAND` through a shell, so SSH receives that argument as its destination instead of the intended host. This blocks clone setup for the explicitly supported quoted form. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git.html?utm_source=openai))

Replace the option inside its existing quotes, or remove the complete shell token.
findings.title: Preserve quoted SSH option boundaries.

findings.body:
**Dissociate clones from inherited alternate object stores.**

In `src/ops/review/addressMany.ts`, Line 201 does not guarantee the independent object store promised by `isolateAddressMany`. If `repoRoot` borrows objects through `objects/info/alternates`, its local clone also borrows those objects. Removing required objects from the alternate repository can then corrupt the worker clone. `--no-hardlinks` does not remove this dependency. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone/2.47.0))

Add `--dissociate` so each worker retains its own required objects. Git documents this option specifically for cloning a repository that already borrows objects. ([git-scm.com](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-clone/?utm_source=openai))
findings.title: Dissociate clones from inherited alternate object stores.

findings.body:
**Count unmeasured dispatches as unknown in the report usage before settling bulk legs as known.**

`account` adds every dispatch's `result.usage` to `report.usage` without checking provenance (address.ts:992-997). Only the ledger record excludes unmeasured dispatches (address.ts:999-1007). `report.usage` starts as zeros (address.ts:452) and is never `undefined`, so `addressMany` always receives a numeric total. A dispatch with unmeasured usage adds zero or partial tokens to that total.

In `addressMany.ts`, `observation` is normalized from this total. `known` is `true` whenever the total normalizes (addressMany.ts:633). The leg then settles as `known` with the partial sum, and the remaining reservation is released. Later PRs can therefore be admitted beyond the token budget. The sticky unknown-usage stop and full-allocation retention apply only when `usage` is missing, so they do not catch this case. `report.usageSummary` (address.ts:698) records the unknown observations, but `addressMany` does not read it.

Guard `known` with the unknown-observation count from `usageSummary`, or make `report.usage` report incomplete measurement. The `KnownUsageSummary` field names were not inspected, so no diff is shown.
findings.title: Count unmeasured dispatches as unknown in the report usage before settling bulk legs as known.
